name: proximo
description: Makes local Docker containers reachable at https://<name>.test with trusted HTTPS and local DNS, and shares a route with colleagues over the team's mesh. Use when exposing a container through proximo.* labels, or when diagnosing a broken one: a .test host that does not answer, a 502/503, an untrusted local certificate, a page that loads and then breaks, a request whose container output you need, a queue or worker that is not progressing, or a shared link that fails.
